finding.detail: Uvicorn0.34 accepts only LOOP_SETUPS keys in setup_event_loop; the new custom dotted loop string would raise KeyError on Windows, despite0.34 being advertised as supported. Uvicorn0.36 introduces get_loop_factory and custom imported callable support.
finding.remediation: Raise minimum to uvicorn>=0.36,<1 or explicitly retain an older-version compatibility path. The installed locked0.52.4 already satisfies0.36; no broad dependency upgrade is needed.

resolved_initial_proposal_defect.problem: Factory returned SelectorEventLoop class rather than loop instance. Uvicorn custom-string branch returns the imported callable directly to asyncio.run; it does not invoke built-in setup-factory protocol.
resolved_initial_proposal_defect.current_fix: Zero-argument callable returns asyncio.SelectorEventLoop(), typed as AbstractEventLoop. Correct for installed0.52.4 and0.36 custom-loop factory protocol.

scope_security_equivalence: Private proposal changes only owned server Config.loop on Windows, retaining non-Windows auto. Reused healthy listener branch creates no loop or server.

local_url, UISession, _port_open and _healthy ASTs are byte-semantically unchanged. Host whitelist, foreign-port detection, exact version/project scope reuse,15-second startup and10+2 shutdown deadlines remain intact.
Existing SDK/operator/approval/Origin/WebSocket peer checks and subscription cancellation code remain untouched.

UI async operations are HTTP/WebSocket sockets, middleware/lifespan, task scheduling/sleep and to_thread. Current SDK API endpoints are synchronous and run in workers. No create_subprocess/pipe transport usage was found in actual API asyncio loop.
Execution CommandRunner uses synchronous Popen; CLI asyncio.run/SDK provider work runs independently. No set_event_loop_policy/process-wide loop modification is introduced.
Direct uvicorn.Server.run creates one owned server thread/process; no uvicorn.run multiprocessing/reload supervisor is introduced.
accepted_scope_limits: Windows Selector uses SelectSelector limited to512 total sockets, including server/wakeup/client descriptors; do not describe this as512 concurrent clients. High local connection loads exceed this bound.
Windows Selector does not implement async subprocesses or pipe transports. Future async provider/harness execution directly on UI ASGI loop would require reevaluation.
No global host/multiprocess/general ASGI guarantee; proposal targets current local socket-only owned UI host.
reset_interpretation: Actual CPython proactor connection-lost callback invokes socket.shutdown before socket.close and server._detach, so WinError10054 can skip subsequent detach in that callback. This supports the hypothesis; observed raw thread stacks do not prove the exact server await chain or causality. Controlled native reset evidence and unchanged full14 browser/deadline qualification are required.

primary_sources.support: setup_event_loop indexes fixed LOOP_SETUPS, no custom string support.
Custom callable get_loop_factory introduced; custom function must return loop instance.

qualification_limits: No native reset/private proposal test executed by reviewer.
Minimum-version contract remains open in actual metadata at report capture.
Original source645 full14 browser/shutdown failures are retained; no claim proposal resolves them.
